summary: Sends a chat reply back for rewriting when it puts a caption before a link or a label where a sentence belongs.
doc: This Stop hook blocks a reply that introduces a link with a caption instead of a sentence, such as "A four-minute tour of the product: <link>" instead of "Here is a demo video: <link>". It also blocks a noun phrase ending in a colon when that phrase sits alone above prose instead of above a list. The model then rewrites the reply as plain sentences. Ordinary engineering replies pass when they use neither shape. Put a quoted shape in a fenced code block, an inline backtick span, a '>' blockquote or double quotes to quote it on purpose. The hook blocks at most once per turn.
